metadata.description: Declarative multi-stage workflow engine for omp — 15 specialized agents, 8 declarative JSON profiles, role-driven DoD gate, profile-driven workflow engine. Native omp plugin (no Claude Code hooks).

plugins.name: omp-workflows
plugins.description: Profile-driven workflow engine for omp. /do-work runs a deterministic 7-phase feature pipeline, /pulse is the read-only project steward, /team-yolo is the autonomous night loop. /team ships as an alias for /do-work. 17 agents, 31 skills, 8 JSON profiles, typed DoD artifact with backstop gate.
